newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real drops 0.07 pct on dollar outflows.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real drops 0.07 pct on dollar outflows.

text.p: Brazil's real closed at 1.0453 per greenback in the commercial foreign exchange market, down 0.07 percent on dollar outflows, dealers said.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Wednesday deficit of $35 million. On Tuesday, net dollar flows posted a $123.3 million deficit.
Dealers also said some banks bought dollars to cover their short positions due to the end of the month because transactions made today will be settled on Friday.
In the interbank foreign exchange floating rate market, the real closed steady at 1.0503 per dollar.
In the illegal parallel market, the real rose 0.91 percent to end at 1.085 per greenback due to an increase in the supply of dollars, traders said.
